explorer:bitcoinxor.payout: Shared TIDES-style rewards paid directly through coinbase; legacy solo service also listed.
explorer:bitcoinxor.protocols: DATUM and a pooled Stratum endpoint; legacy Stratum V1 solo is described as being wound down.
explorer:bitcoinxor.template: Own node and gateway for DATUM; pool creates templates on its pooled Stratum endpoint.
explorer:bitcoinxor.researchNotes: The homepage lists 5% for the pool-built-template endpoint, while the DATUM guide also displays a general 1% pool fee. Confirm the endpoint-specific total before connecting.

research:omegapool.name: OmegaPool
research:omegapool.fee: 0% own gateway; 10% on public-gateway work. 75% of that charge is redistributed to own-gateway miners; 25% stays with the pool.
research:omegapool.payout: Website states proportional work-window payouts directly in coinbase, with an 8x network-difficulty window. Public-gateway charges and redistribution affect the split.
research:omegapool.minimum: 0.00000546 (546 sats per split; below-threshold work stays in the window for a later block).
research:omegapool.protocols: DATUM: pool.iohzrd.tech:28915 (gateway connections). Public Stratum V1: gateway.iohzrd.tech:23334 (BLAKE2b hardware).
research:omegapool.template: Own node and DATUM gateway: operator claims miner-selected templates. Public gateway: operator selects transactions. Neither path has been independently assessed by XBT Pulse.
research:omegapool.researchNotes: Public website snapshot, not an operator submission or telemetry approval. Advertises RATUM Prime 0.1.38. Public gateway refuses new connections above its configured 10% network-share threshold; existing miners continue, so this is not a hard pool-size cap. No block attribution has been linked to this researched profile.
